CustomField.inlineHelpText: The addresses Cc'd on the message that carried this link, snapshotted from Global CC Emails when the link was issued. The report page offers these alongside the recipient when a one-time code is requested, so a Cc'd reader can have the code sent to their own mailbox instead of the facility's. Held on the link rather than read from config at request time, so changing the config never widens a link that is already out.
CustomField.label: CC Emails
